name: com.coffeebean.asset
description: Asset management module for the CoffeeBean framework: unified loading facade over Unity Addressables (sync/async/instantiate/preload/label/ref-counted release/stats) + UI component binding extensions (Image/TMP_Text/Text/SpriteRenderer/AudioClip) + catalog update service. Async is built on UniTask (pooled awaiters, main-thread resumption, cancellation). Declares com.unity.addressables and com.cysharp.unitask as dependencies (sources provided by the consumer). Depends on com.coffeebean.tools.
